newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian industrial output 1.2 pct down in August.
newsitem.headline: Romanian industrial output 1.2 pct down in August.

text.p: Romanian industry slipped by 1.2 percent in August from July but was up 9.3 percent from August 1995, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed.
ROMANIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT AUG 96 JULY 96 AUG 95
NOTE: Figures were adjusted according to the number of working days.
The CNS said industrial production was 6.2 trillion lei in August, while eight-month output stood at 41.3 trillion lei or up 8.4 percent from the year-ago period.
Some 19 percent of January-August output went to export, nearly flat from the same period last year.
Manufacturing industry surged by 10.5 percent over January-August from the year ago period, while output in the power sector rose by 6.2 percent and the extractive industry saw a 0.6 percent fall.
Productivity per hour rose by 1.0 percent last month from July and by 10.4 percent year-on-year.
Industry employed 2.228 million people at end-August, 5,500 less than the previous month. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
